subject: Operations
title: Space Manufacturing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Space Manufacturing usable.

hook.text: In microgravity, fiber optic cables can be made flawlessly. Some products are better manufactured in space.

buildup.text: Space manufacturing leverages orbit's unique conditions—microgravity, vacuum, extreme temps—to build superior goods.

discovery.text: Experiments on the ISS have produced better pharmaceuticals, purer crystals, and defect-free fiber optics.

twist.text: Launch costs fell from $54,000/kg in 1981 to under $1,500/kg with SpaceX. The economics are nearing viability.

climax.text: Startups like Varda Space and Made In Space are building orbital factories for commercial production.

punchline.text: The next factory floor might orbit 400 km above Earth.
